proposal.hypothesis: MiniZinc may express global constraints more directly than the current CPMpy fixture, improving final_solution_accuracy_percent after local evaluator dependencies are available.
proposal.risk: MiniZinc Python package and external solver may be unavailable, so the proposal must stop at the dependency gate until the environment is installed.
proposal.rollback_plan: Keep the CPMpy baseline artifact as the default path and reject promotion unless MiniZinc local-eval score improves on a comparable split.

claim_boundary: CP-Bench proposal-round artifact only; it records guard decisions and rollback evidence without uploading to Hugging Face or claiming leaderboard scores.
